case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's header case title.

number_of_accused.reason: Single appellant, Karthi @ Karthick, is the only accused whose liability is decided.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to with male pronouns throughout the judgment.

accused_age.correct_value: Not stated as an exact number; judgment says accused was 'aged above 20 years'
accused_age.quote: The accused appellant was aged above 20 years at the time of occurrence.
accused_age.reason: Judgment gives a lower bound, not an exact age; 'Not stated' omits the stated 'above 20'.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused appears in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Judgment says accused shares the victim's caste but never names it.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class; the money allegation is a defence claim about the victim's family.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment says nothing about any prior criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is the female prosecutrix Poomari (PW1).

victim_age.correct_value: Not stated as an exact number; judgment says victim was 'aged between 18 to 20 years'
victim_age.quote: At the time of occurrence, she was aged between 18 to 20 years.
victim_age.reason: Judgment gives an age range; 'Not stated' ignores the stated range.

victim_caste.reason: Caste is implied as shared with the accused but never named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Neighbour relationship, teasing, marriage proposals and repeated relations over six months are all described.

offence_category.reason: Main offence is rape under s.376, with cheating under s.417 as the companion charge.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment states convictions under Sections 376 and 417 IPC.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned; the accused's hand was used to gag the victim.

evidence_type.reason: Testimonial, panchayat circumstantial evidence, friends' statements and medical examination all appear in the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is relied on; the s.313 statement is a denial.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Gagging, deceit to secure silence and repeated intercourse over six months are all noted.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under ss.376 and 417 is stated; no sentence is given in the judgment.

high_court_outcome.reason: Madras High Court dismissed the revision on 18.12.2006, upholding conviction.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction under ss.376 and 417 IPC was upheld.

imprisonment_type.reason: Judgment refers only to 'the remaining part of the sentence' without stating its type.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed-term sentence length is stated.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers the incident, disclosure, panchayat and evidence without names, court proceedings or outcome, within length.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory punishment for s.376 or s.417.

attempt_completion.reason: Sexual intercourse was completed according to the judgment.

physical_harm.reason: Only the gagging is described; no injury findings are reported.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is involved.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court does not find premeditation or planning; the deceit finding is not framed as planning.

motive.reason: Court does not identify a motive; the extortion motive is only the accused's s.313 allegation.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Victim, brother, father, panchayat elders and the two friends' statements are the evidence relied on.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found witnesses not shaken and the victim's testimony undented by cross-examination.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Disclosure, panchayat, police complaint on 10.10.2003 and surrender on 5.11.2003 are all noted.

custody_duration.reason: Custody period is not computed or stated in the judgment.

bail_history.reason: Supreme Court bail order dated 4.4.2008 is stated; no other bail history appears.

trial_duration.reason: Trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment; offence date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondent match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.reason: Complaint, investigation, charge-sheet, committal and trial with 16 witnesses and 12 exhibits are stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the court.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, appellate affirmance, High Court revision dismissal and SC dismissal match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment does not summarise the State's arguments in the Supreme Court.

defence_argument.reason: Consent, no promise, afterthought/delay and reliance on Uday and Zinder Ali Sheikh match contentions recorded.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Deceit-based consent, commitment of marriage and delay in FIR principles match the court's reasoning.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Uday v. State of Karnataka (2003) 4 SCC 46 and Zinder Ali Sheikh v. State of West Bengal (2009) 3 SCC 761 were referred to, cited by appellant's counsel; the Court relied on neither
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Uday v. State of Karnataka (2003) 4 SCC 46 and Zinder Ali Sheikh vs. State of West Bengal & Anr. (2009) 3 SCC 761 - referred to.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Court only referred to these cases and decided on facts; it did not rely on them.

sentencing_rationale.reason: The judgment does not impose or discuss a fresh sentence.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court weighs no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: None for sentencing; court relied on deceit only for liability and did not weigh aggravating factors for sentence
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: Obtaining consent by exercising deceit, cannot be legitimate defence to exculpate an accused.
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Deceit is used to reject consent for liability; no sentencing aggravation is weighed, so listing it is questionable.

other_sentence_order.reason: Court directs the accused to be taken into custody to serve the remaining sentence.
